llmnav-catalog/1 repository=llmnav catalog=llmnav.evidence
Read semantic cards before opening source. Resolve current paths and signatures with llmnav query or show.

@llmnav.evidence.files
role Hash explicitly selected repository files for local provenance without retaining their contents.
owns evidence path containment, bounded byte fingerprints, file handle lifetime
excludes semantic card validation, secret content storage
invariant Evidence paths remain inside the repository and open handles close after errors or cancellation.

@llmnav.evidence.history
role Read file-level Git provenance and current index and worktree state only when requested.
owns file change commits, staging state, bounded history cache
excludes function change dates, semantic card validation, repository mutation
invariant Git dates describe files and volatile provenance never enters deterministic navigation artifacts.
rel workflow>llmnav.evidence.files

@llmnav.evidence.verification
role Store caller-reported validation receipts and compare their declared inputs with current files.
owns verification snapshots, content-addressed receipts, source applicability, evidence links
excludes test execution, function coverage claims, semantic card validation
invariant Execution outcomes and current applicability remain separate and incomplete input coverage yields unknown applicability.
rel workflow>llmnav.evidence.files
